title: Add plain-english-styles as a federated marketplace entry
description: Dispatched by opum-agent (opum-doc DEC-168 (6)). plain-english-styles is a new public repo (github.com/opum-ai/plain-english-styles, MIT) shipping three Claude Code output styles (Beginner, Intermediate, Advanced) built on ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English: every update answers what was done, whether it worked and what you do next, with decisions as two options and a recommendation. Repo-root layout (.claude-plugin/plugin.json and output-styles/ at the root); it ships no skills/ directory, so its recorded baseline subtree is output-styles/ (the content that defines the plugin behaviour), following the yaml-lsp precedent for a non-skills plugin. Pin v0.1.0 (annotated tag). Independently resolved via the GitHub git-database API before pinning: tag ref v0.1.0 -> tag object 6f5680bed4ee2fb634b53461ab1ce4f6504d9cfa (type=tag) -> commit bf3f253457a7e4777b083fcb727d7c773506722d (also the repo dev HEAD) -> root tree ded005ef5fb7d55c4f147c466c876d7cc5e42887 -> output-styles subtree 2445b5603f915a135a89532a4d3ff1a4c760d291, containing plain-english-beginner.md, plain-english-intermediate.md and plain-english-advanced.md. plugin.json at the tag declares name plain-english-styles, version 0.1.0, author {name: Opum AI, url: https://github.com/opum-ai}, license MIT.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A plugins[] entry named "plain-english-styles" exists in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json with source {source:"github", repo:"opum-ai/plain-english-styles", ref:"v0.1.0"}, author {name:"Opum AI", url:"https://github.com/opum-ai"}, category productivity, and homepage https://github.com/opum-ai/plain-english-styles

scripts/federated-pin-baselines.json records a plain-english-styles baseline for v0.1.0 with an independently-resolved output-styles/ subtree SHA (tag ref -> tag object -> commit -> root tree -> output-styles subtree), not a relayed one taken on trust
node scripts/check-federated-pins.mjs and node scripts/check-federated-content.mjs both report plain-english-styles checked/verified (not skipped) against the live tag
node scripts/generate-codex-marketplace.mjs --check passes after regenerating .agents/plugins/marketplace.json for the new entry
The marketplace description, README.md and docs/reference/marketplace-federation-contract.md name and count eight plugins, including plain-english-styles
check · manifests, lore check and Tracker integrity are green in CI on the PR head SHA

finalSummary: Added plain-english-styles (opum-ai/plain-english-styles, pinned v0.1.0, MIT) as an eighth federated entry in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json - github source, author {name: Opum AI, url: https://github.com/opum-ai}, category productivity, homepage https://github.com/opum-ai/plain-english-styles - per opum-doc DEC-168 (6). It is an output-styles plugin with no skills/ directory, so the recorded baseline is the output-styles/ subtree 2445b5603f915a135a89532a4d3ff1a4c760d291, resolved independently via the GitHub git-database API (annotated tag v0.1.0 -> tag object 6f5680bed4ee2fb634b53461ab1ce4f6504d9cfa -> commit bf3f253457a7e4777b083fcb727d7c773506722d == dev HEAD -> root tree ded005ef5fb7d55c4f147c466c876d7cc5e42887 -> output-styles/); plugin.json at the tag declares version 0.1.0. Regenerated .agents/plugins/marketplace.json; README.md and docs/reference/marketplace-federation-contract.md updated from seven plugins to eight; docs/reference/federated-pin-verification.md now names output-styles/ among the recorded subtrees; lore sync. Verified locally (claude plugin validate, both federated checkers naming plain-english-styles, codex --check, the 25-case JS suite plus the fast-forward guard suite, lore check 0 errors) and in CI: PR opum-ai/opum-marketplace#199, run 37543510217 on head ce63eb2, check · manifests / lore check / Tracker integrity all green, with the manifests job log naming plain-english-styles as checked and content-verified. Closed inside PR #199, the closure commit following the validated deliverable commit on the same branch.
